title: A measure of grain for one, straw for another
odia:
କାହା ମୁହଁକୁ ଧାନ ଭରଣେ
କାହା ମୁହଁକୁ ପାଳ ଭରଣେ।
literal_meaning: To one person’s mouth, a measure of paddy; to another’s, a measure of straw.
meaning_odia: କାହାକୁ ଉପକାରୀ ଜିନିଷ ମିଳୁଛି, ଆଉ କାହାକୁ ସେହି ପରିମାଣରେ ଅନୁପଯୋଗୀ ଜିନିଷ। ଧାନ ଓ ପାଳର ତୁଳନାରେ ଏକା ମାପର ଭାଗ ଥିଲେ ମଧ୍ୟ ତାହାର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଓ ଉପକାର ସମାନ ନହେବାର କଥା ଦେଖାଯାଏ।
explanation: Both portions are described by the same measure, but one contains grain and the other straw. The repeated quantity makes the unequal substance more striking. This edition reads the image as a contrast in what different people actually receive.
usage_example: Two groups receive packages of the same size, but one contains useful supplies and the other mostly packing material. Someone recalls the saying. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: Grain and straw come from the same crop but have different uses. Placing them before mouths sharpens the contrast between what can provide nourishment after preparation and what cannot serve that purpose for people.

odia_summary: ମାପ ଏକା ହେଲେ ବି ମିଳୁଥିବା ଜିନିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ଏକା ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Matching measures can contain very unequal shares of value.
